structures.name: door
structures.description: A sliding pressure door, shut. It holds air.

structures.name: jammed door
structures.description: A sliding pressure door, buckled in its frame. It won't slide open on its own; something would have to lever it.

structures.name: open door
structures.description: A sliding pressure door, open. Air passes through it.

structures.name: airlock door
structures.description: A heavy pressure hatch with a thick viewport and a gauge on each side. Its breach interlock won't open it onto a compartment venting to space unless the other side is a sealed airlock. Once the far side is sealed, open both doors to let air in.

structures.name: open airlock door
structures.description: A heavy pressure hatch, swung open. Air passes through it.

structures.name: damaged door
structures.description: A door frame with the door cut out of it, the edges still bright from the laser. Air passes freely, and it won't shut again until it's repaired.
